evidence: Cic. de Or. 1.28: duōbus spatiīs tribusve factīs, after two or three turns (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: A course or a turn round it; Lewis & Short gives also “a race-course, track”.

sources: Lewis & Short: spatium · Lewis & Short: curriculum
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 51.
